prompt: Navy plants a garden behind the school
title: School Garden Grow
irony: Navy plants seeds to keep a garden of his own, but the seeds only grow when he gives sprouts away and waits, and giving and waiting fill the schoolyard.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning light fills the big house yard as Navy lifts three seed packets high.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Navy wants a garden behind the school and believes Black's tale of giant moon beans.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black bets tiny seeds never sprout and dumps sand over Navy's marked rows.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends chant by the seed rows and pat the sandy soil flat.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: At the school plot Blue floods the beds with a huge tank while Green reads and refuses mud.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Water drags all seeds into one corner where the kids slip and land in a muddy heap.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Muddy and stuck, the friends chant by the puddled rows.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Blue holds the empty tank and sees big things cannot buy slow growing time.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Blue sets the hose down to tend each day and Navy hands spare sprouts to classmates.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The schoolyard blooms as friends chant and share beans and marigolds.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Evening glows over shared baskets as Navy gives his last pumpkin to Black.
